thread:
rebecca: Quick flag — Mistralix onboarding health. Since they switched models we saw p95 latency jump and unit cost creep. Renewal risk flagged yellow (~60% in 30d). Thinking proactive: recommend int8 quant on candidate + canary model-swap + route heavy tails to Dedicated pool. Thoughts?

sam: Can you drop the key numbers and request mix? need avg tokens, tail % and concurrency to size the quant test.

rebecca: Here are the quick metrics from their prod window (last 72h):
```
model: llama-2-13b-instruct (hosted)
p50: 240ms
p95: 1.8s
error rate: 0.8%
avg input tokens: 120
avg output tokens: 75
% requests >512 tokens: 18%
peak concurrency: 45 req/s
monthly tokens: 120M
est. unit cost: $0.35 / 1k tokens
```
Notably 18% long requests and a visible p95 tail during peak hours.

jordan: Two levers that make sense: 1) int8 quant of a compatible variant — we've seen ~25-35% p95 drop on similar mixes; 2) a canary model-swap to a denser, lower-latency variant (e.g., redwood-qlora-13b-rt) with traffic ramping. Also suggest per-prefix routing for known long prompts so they hit dedicated pool.

maria: Ops note — moving their prod traffic to Dedicated flattens the tail but needs a capacity commit. We can run a short canary on Dedicated during low-impact hours. I can author an autoscale policy: target p95 < 1s, max burst 60.

rebecca: Good. For quality gating: we'll run a 200-prompt eval (mix of short/long + function calls). Sam, can you own eval and collect latency + hallucination/regression metrics?

sam: Yep. I'll run eval against: (a) current hosted model, (b) int8 candidate, (c) redwood-qlora-13b-rt canary. ETA end of day tomorrow. I'll capture ROUGE, hallucination rate, and token breakdown to estimate cost delta.

rebecca: I'll draft the customer note and get AM alignment. Jordan, can you draft the rollout steps and fallback policy (auto-fallback to hosted base model) so CS/AM can sign off?

jordan: On it. Planned rollout schedule in doc: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 48h with automated rollback criteria: p95 > 1.2s OR accuracy delta > 2% on eval set. Will include commands for route changes and a manual override.

deploy-bot: canary-job queued: "mistralix-canary" on dedicated-pool-2 — awaiting green from eval.

maria: I scheduled a Sat 02:00 PT window for the canary to minimize user impact and added capacity guardrails. Also added tracing hooks so we can slice by prompt prefix.

rebecca: Action items: sam -> run eval; jordan -> rollout doc + fallback; maria -> autoscale + canary window; rebecca -> customer comms + open ticket. I'll open CS-5234 and link results once eval is in. :thumbsup: 

sam: quick note — if int8 shows small regressions on long code-like prompts we should include a short A/B quality test with real user flows before moving beyond 20%.

rebecca: Agreed. We'll keep 20% gate for 24h with live QA checks. I'll coordinate with AM for Tue 09:00 PT canary (they prefer morning).

jordan: Draft done, pushing to the ticket. Includes rollback commands and traffic-weight examples.

rebecca: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after eval results.
